Iris (Docs): FYI we've added a developer glossary page to clarify terms like 'model variant', 'dedicated pool', and 'cold-start'. Please review for consistency with SDK docs.
Ken (SDK): Nice. Any definitions that conflict with SDK terminology?
Iris (Docs): We changed a few labels: 'model variant' is now canonical (was 'model variant / flavor' in older samples). Also 'cold-start' definition includes GPU warmup time.
Omar (Product): Good - helps reduce support churn. Can we add a one-line note for account teams: 'Canonical glossary live; SDK samples updated to match.'
Ken (SDK): I'll sync sample generators to use "model_variant" variable naming where applicable. Will open PR this afternoon.
docs-bot: [automated] page updated: /docs/glossary (revision 2026-05-10T09:20Z)
Iris (Docs): Thanks — please react :thumbsup: when your area is done so we can ship the small cross-doc update.
